request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:MOUND

layers.text: Change only the orange cone on top: it becomes a big drill bit, wider at its base, of polished copper #d06a2a with three dark #3d2a1e spiral grooves winding round it and a small light grey steel point, so it is clearly a drill and not a flame. Keep the round heap of dark brown earth, the grey rocks, the white steam puff, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
